$comment: Single source of truth for the shared MCP server set. dotfiles/ai/mcp/render.py renders every client config from these definitions (--write) and checks it (--check); dotfiles/ai/validate.py runs that check, so drift fails the build. Commands are absolute because Dock- and Finder-launched editors inherit a minimal PATH, and the mise shim is preferred over CodeGraph's own --print-config value: a bare `codegraph` is not on a GUI client's PATH, and the versioned install path (installs/node/<version>/bin) breaks on the next Node upgrade.
primaryRationale: Code intelligence is the first tool for symbol, call-graph, and impact questions; plain-text search stays the fallback for config, docs, and un-indexed projects. AGENTS.md carries the instruction so every agent applies it.
expoPolicyRationale: Expo is the only remote, account-scoped server here: it can spend EAS compute, publish to public store listings, rewrite project dependencies, and proxy simulator screenshots and device logs off the machine. Clients with a deny mechanism refuse these outright; every other expo tool still needs explicit per-call approval.
